lines.text: Manasseh becomes king at twelve, reigns fifty-five years in Jerusalem, and rebuilds the high places his father Hezekiah destroyed.
Manasseh builds altars in the LORD's house, sacrifices his son in fire, and sets the Asherah pole in the temple.
The LORD says through the prophets that He will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes out a table.
Manasseh fills Jerusalem with innocent blood, is buried in the garden of Uzza, and his son Amon reigns two years.
Amon's servants kill him in his palace, and the people of the land make his son Ahaz king.
